<div class="hero-visual fade-in-up">

<div class="floating-stat stat-1"><span class="stat-icon">📈</span><span>20+ Praktikum</span></div>

<div class="dashboard-mockup">
<div class="mockup-header">
<div class="mockup-dot red"></div>
<div class="mockup-dot yellow"></div>
<div class="mockup-dot green"></div>
<span class="mockup-title">R Console — Lab Interaktif</span>
<button class="run-btn ms-auto">▶ Run Code</button>
</div>
<div class="mockup-code">
<div><span class="code-comment"># Visualisasi Data Iris</span></div>
<div><span class="code-fn">library</span><span class="code-var">(ggplot2)</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;</div>
<div><span class="code-fn">ggplot</span><span class="code-var">(iris, </span><span class="code-fn">aes</span><span class="code-var">(</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-kw">x</span> <span class="code-var">= Sepal.Length,</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-kw">y</span> <span class="code-var">= Sepal.Width,</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-kw">color</span> <span class="code-var">= Species)) +</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-fn">geom_point</span><span class="code-var">(size = </span><span class="code-num">3</span><span class="code-var">) +</span></div>
<div>&nbsp;&nbsp;<span class="code-fn">theme_minimal</span><span class="code-var">()</span></div>
</div>
<div class="mockup-output">
<div class="output-card"><div class="output-label">Mean Sepal.Length</div><div class="output-value">5.84</div></div>
<div class="output-card"><div class="output-label">Korelasi</div><div class="output-value">0.87</div></div>
<div class="output-card"><div class="output-label">Distribusi</div><div class="output-value">Normal</div></div>
<div class="output-card"><div class="output-label">R² Model</div><div class="output-value">0.93</div></div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</div>
